snippet.title: Gary Oldman Says Potter TV Wins?
snippet.description:
Gary Oldman, who played Sirius Black in the Harry Potter movies, says HBO's new television adaptation could be "more satisfying" because it has room for character details the films cut. His comments appeared in Entertainment Weekly on September 11, 2026. That is Oldman's expectation, not a review or a promise of quality. He also says he remains proud of the films. HBO had not announced its new Sirius Black in the report; Oldman did not confirm a return.

Source: https://ew.com/gary-oldman-says-harry-potter-tv-show-will-be-more-satisfying-than-films-because-of-this-change-12116322
Additional reporting: https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/gary-oldman-hbo-harry-potter-series-more-satisfying-than-movies-1236859390/
